name: Shenzhen Worldunion Group Incorporated
summary: Shenzhen Worldunion Group Incorporated provides real estate services in China. The company provides new house, e-commerce, stock, and overseas transaction services. It offers apartment and home decoration solutions for institutional and C-end customers; short-term financing services for property owners; community housekeeping services; and matching asset service solutions.
